errors.text_span: През 2020 г. линията остава в диапазона между 5,5% и 6,5%, с няколко върха и понижения.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect for the entirety of 2020, as the line reaches a low of approximately 3.5% in June. Even if it refers only to the second half of the year (July-December), the actual range is approximately 5.9% to 6.2%, not 5.5% to 6.5%.

errors.text_span: През 2021 г. линията започва със стойност около 6,5% през януари
errors.evidence: The value for January 2021 is visibly higher than the stated 6.5%; it is approximately 6.8%.

errors.text_span: От юни 2021 г. до юни 2022 г. линията остава в диапазон между 2% и 3%
errors.evidence: The statement that the line remains between 2% and 3% during this period is incorrect. In November 2021, the value clearly rises above 3%, reaching a peak of approximately 3.2%.

errors.text_span: като завършва при стойност около 1,8% през юни 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The final value in June 2022 is visibly lower than the stated 1.8%. It is approximately 1.5%.
